class.name: FmodGeneralSettings
class.brief_description: General initialization settings for the FMOD Studio system.
class.description:
FmodGeneralSettings configures the core FMOD Studio system. Pass an instance to [method FmodServer.init] when initializing manually, or configure the equivalent values in the FMOD section of Project Settings for auto-initialization.
[codeblock] var settings = FmodGeneralSettings.new() settings.channel_count = 1024 settings.is_live_update_enabled = false settings.banks_path = "res://audio/" FmodServer.init(settings) [/codeblock]

method.name: get_banks_path
method.description: Returns the path used for automatic bank loading.

method.name: get_channel_count
method.description: Returns the maximum number of FMOD channels (virtual voices).

method.name: get_default_listener_count
method.description: Returns the default number of listeners to initialize FMOD with.

method.name: get_is_live_update_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if FMOD Live Update is enabled, allowing the FMOD Studio editor to connect and adjust the mix at runtime.

method.name: get_is_memory_tracking_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if FMOD memory tracking is enabled.

method.name: get_should_load_by_name
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if banks should be located by name when using the auto-load path.

method.name: set_banks_path
method.description: Sets the directory path used for automatic bank loading.

method.name: set_channel_count
method.description: Sets the maximum number of FMOD channels (virtual voices). Higher values allow more simultaneous sounds but use more memory.

method.name: set_default_listener_count
method.description: Sets the default number of listeners. Use values above 1 only for split-screen or multi-listener setups.

method.name: set_is_live_update_enabled
method.description: Enables or disables FMOD Live Update. Disable in release builds to avoid exposing a live-update server.

method.name: set_is_memory_tracking_enabled
method.description: Enables or disables FMOD memory usage tracking. Enable to see memory stats via [method FmodServer.get_performance_data].

method.name: set_should_load_by_name
method.description: Sets whether banks in the auto-load path should be located by name rather than by path.

members.member: Directory path used for automatic bank discovery and loading.
Maximum number of FMOD channels (virtual voices). Default is 1024.
Initial number of FMOD listeners. Increase for split-screen. Default is 1.
Whether FMOD Live Update is active, allowing the FMOD Studio editor to connect at runtime. Disable in shipped builds.
Whether FMOD memory tracking is enabled.
Whether to locate banks by name in the auto-load path.
